My girlfriend broke up with me. Although I know it's the best outcome for both of us, I still can't let it go.
</message>
output: I keep replaying the last moments of our time together, wondering if I could have said something differently, if I could have shown up more, and it leaves me feeling hollow and stuck, like a part of me is still waiting for her to come back and tell me it’s okay.
